# Isadora Lash & Brows

> Elevating your everyday beauty. Lash & Brow Artist in London specializing in lash extensions, brows, and lip hydration.

## At a Glance / Em Resumo
- **Professional**: Isadora – Lash & Brow Artist
- **Location**: London, United Kingdom (Private studio, exact address provided upon booking confirmation)
- **Instagram**: @isadorab.lash (https://www.instagram.com/isadorab.lash/)
- **Booking**: Exclusively via WhatsApp (+44 7387 625779)
- **Languages**: Portuguese (Português do Brasil) and English

## Services Offered
- **Lash Extensions**:
  - Fox Eyes: Elongated, lifted outer-corner mapping for a cat-eye, feline aesthetic.
  - Volume 5D: Lightweight handmade fans for plush density and elegance without natural lash strain.
  - Brazilian Volume (Volume Brasileiro): Signature textured volume with soft, fluttery finish.
  - Siren Effect: Seductive, lifted outer-corner textured lash mapping with glamorous drama.
- **Brow Services**:
  - Brow Design (Design de sobrancelhas): Personalized anatomical mapping suited to facial architecture.
  - Brow Lamination: Directional discipline and alignment for fuller, brushed-up fluffy brows.
- **Lip Care**:
  - Hidralips: Deep hydrating, smoothing, and revitalizing lip aesthetic treatment.

## Safety & Standards
- Strict UK hygiene, sanitation protocols, and single-use sterilization.
- Comprehensive consultation, eye shape mapping, and allergy patch testing where indicated.
- Individual client sessions ensuring total privacy and relaxation.
